items.title: Projecting potential population exposure to the invasive malaria vector Anopheles stephensi
items.title_en: Projecting potential population exposure to the invasive malaria vector Anopheles stephensi
items.title_zh: 对入侵性疟疾媒介——斯蒂芬氏按蚊（Anopheles stephensi）可能造成的人口暴露情况进行预测
items.summary_en: Malaria remains a major global public health threat, and the recent invasion and rapid spread of Anopheles stephensi across Africa pose new challenges for disease control. To assess future risks, we estimated the distribution of An. stephensi habitat suitability under four Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs, SSP126, SSP245, SSP370 and SSP585) across 2021–2100 using a boosted regression tree model, and quantified population exposure through a contribution decomposition framework separating environmental, population and joint effects. The results showed that the proportion of urban land was the most important predictor (17.17%), followed by mean temperature of the wettest quarter (BIO8, 9.24%) and the annual mean temperature (BIO1, 8.24%). Suitable habitats expanded consistently under all scenarios. Notably, SSP370 generated the highest population exposure, and there would be approximately 205.51 million people living in high suitability habitats for An. stephensi by 2081–2100. From the contribution decomposition framework, population change dominated the total exposure increase, outweighing environmental effects and joint effects. However, the individual contributions of population and environmental effects gradually declined over time, while their joint effect increased. These findings demonstrated that population growth, rather than climate change alone, is the primary driver of future exposure to An. stephensi. The increasing joint effect of population and environmental factors further underscores the need for integrated, region‐specific interventions that address their combined influence on transmission risk.
items.summary_zh: 疟疾仍是全球公共卫生面临的主要威胁，而斯蒂芬氏按蚊（Anopheles stephensi）近期在非洲的入侵和快速蔓延，给疾病防控带来了新的挑战。为了评估未来风险，我们利用增强回归树模型，估算了2021–2100年期间斯蒂芬氏按蚊在四条“共享社会经济路径”（SSPs，即SSP126、 SSP245、SSP370和SSP585）下，利用增强回归树模型估算了2021–2100年期间斯氏按蚊栖息地适宜性的分布，并通过贡献分解框架将环境、人口及联合效应分离，从而量化了人口暴露情况。 结果显示，城市用地比例是最重要的预测因子（17.17%），其次是降水最丰沛季度（BIO8）的平均气温（9.24%）和年平均气温（BIO1，8.24%）。在所有情景下，适宜栖息地均呈持续扩张趋势。 值得注意的是，SSP370情景导致的人口暴露水平最高，到2081–2100年，将有约2.0551亿人生活在An. stephensi的高适宜栖息地中。 根据贡献分解框架，人口变化是总暴露量增加的主要因素，其影响超过了环境效应和联合效应。然而，人口和环境效应的单独贡献随时间推移逐渐下降，而其联合效应则有所增加。这些发现表明，人口增长而非气候变化本身，是未来斯蒂芬氏按蚊暴露风险的主要驱动因素。 人口与环境因素日益增强的联合效应进一步凸显了采取综合性、针对具体地区的干预措施的必要性，以应对这两者对传播风险的综合影响。

items.title: Evaluating inter- and intra-regional air pollution inequalities in a decarbonized world
items.title_en: Evaluating inter- and intra-regional air pollution inequalities in a decarbonized world
items.title_zh: 评估脱碳世界中区域间和区域内的空气污染不平等现象
items.summary_en: Ambient PM2.5 exposure remains a major global health challenge. While pollution has declined in developed economies, it has increased in developing regions, exacerbating cross-country inequalities. Within-country disparities have narrowed in some contexts but remain significant. This study assesses how these inequalities evolve under alternative decarbonization futures, co-designed with stakeholders and aligned with current climate policy. Using an integrated assessment and air quality modelling framework, we find that international inequality in mortality burden widens over time even as income inequality across countries narrows, and that a country’s emission contribution is only moderately associated with its own exposure burden, driven more by aggregate scale than per-capita intensity. Within countries, wealthier deciles disproportionately drive emissions, but the contribution-exposure relationship shows no consistent direction, and exposure inequality itself varies enormously by country independent of income. These findings call for climate policies explicitly integrated with air quality, health, and equity objectives, tailored to where responsibility and impact diverge across scales.
items.summary_zh: 环境中的PM2.5暴露问题仍然是全球健康面临的一大挑战。虽然发达经济体的污染水平有所下降，但发展中地区的污染却在加剧，这进一步加剧了各国之间的不平等。 在某些情况下，国内不平等现象虽有所缓解，但依然显著。本研究评估了在与利益相关方共同设计、并与当前气候政策相一致的多种脱碳未来情景下，这些不平等现象将如何演变。 通过综合评估和空气质量建模框架，我们发现，即使各国间的收入不平等有所缩小，死亡负担的国际不平等随时间推移仍在扩大；且一个国家的排放贡献与其自身的暴露负担仅存在中度关联，这更多是由总排放规模而非人均排放强度所驱动。 在各国国内，较富裕的十分位群体对排放的贡献不成比例地高，但贡献与暴露之间的关系并未呈现一致的趋势，且暴露不平等本身在各国之间存在巨大差异，且与收入水平无关。这些发现呼吁制定将空气质量、健康和公平目标明确整合到气候政策中的措施，并针对不同尺度下责任与影响不一致的情况量身定制。

items.title: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_en: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_zh: 自然气候解决方案与植物入侵之间的反馈作用
items.summary_en: Biological invasions and carbon sequestration guide many modern-day land management decisions. However, intersections between invasions and natural climate solutions (NCS)—actions to maintain or increase the land carbon sink—have not received adequate attention in either the invasion or climate mitigation literature. We therefore review how plant invasions affect NCS and vice versa, focusing on reductions in emissions and carbon removals associated with avoided habitat conversion, restoration, forest and cropland management, agroforestry, and optimal grazing. We find that plant invasions can interfere with rapid NCS implementation and reduce the durability of carbon storage in many systems, although there are cases in which invasive plants increase carbon storage, creating biodiversity-climate mitigation trade-offs. At the same time, studies find that several NCS increase community resistance/resilience to invasions, and do so in forests, in particular, which can suppress invasive species spread in these systems. These dynamics suggest a positive feedback loop between NCS and invasions, in which NCS facilitate invasion control, and successful invasion control, in turn, eases further NCS implementation. This feedback could accelerate gains in land-based carbon storage and generate co-benefits for biodiversity, provided that NCS projects receive resources for sustained invasive species management. We highlight areas in need of further research, including how financial mechanisms for climate action could be used to overcome invasion-induced implementation barriers.
items.summary_zh: 生物入侵和碳封存是当今许多土地管理决策的重要依据。然而，入侵与自然气候解决方案（NCS）——即旨在维持或增加土地碳汇的举措——之间的交集，无论是在入侵研究文献还是气候减缓文献中，都尚未得到充分关注。 因此，我们回顾了植物入侵如何影响自然气候解决方案，反之亦然，重点探讨了通过避免栖息地转化、生态修复、森林和农田管理、农林复合经营以及优化放牧所带来的减排和碳移除效应。 我们发现，尽管在某些情况下入侵植物会增加碳储量，从而产生生物多样性与气候减缓之间的权衡，但植物入侵可能会干扰自然气候解决方案的快速实施，并降低许多系统中碳储存的持久性。 与此同时，研究发现，若干自然碳储量措施可增强群落对入侵的抵抗力/韧性，特别是在森林中，从而抑制入侵物种在这些系统中的扩散。 这些动态表明，NCS 与入侵之间存在正反馈循环：NCS 有助于控制入侵，而成功的入侵控制反过来又促进了 NCS 的进一步实施。只要 NCS 项目获得用于持续管理入侵物种的资源，这种反馈就能加速陆地碳储量的增长，并为生物多样性带来协同效益。 我们重点指出了需要进一步研究的领域，包括如何利用气候行动的金融机制来克服入侵物种引发的实施障碍。

items.title: Far-right slows energy transition
items.title_zh: 极右翼势力阻碍能源转型
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01974-wPolitical identity is known to shape climate attitudes, but its effect on real-world adoption of clean technologies has been unclear. Now, data from Germany show that rising far-right support slows the uptake of rooftop solar and electric cars. However, these effects are not large enough to stall the transition.

items.title: Scientists confirm global warming is accelerating faster than ever recorded
items.title_en: Scientists confirm global warming is accelerating faster than ever recorded
items.title_zh: 科学家证实，全球变暖的速度正以有史以来最快的速度加快
items.summary_en: Earth is warming faster than ever recorded, with scientists detecting a major acceleration in global temperatures since around 2015. A new study reveals that the warming rate has surged to approximately 0.35°C per decade, nearly double the average pace observed from 1970 to 2015. After removing natural climate fluctuations, researchers confirmed the acceleration with more than 98% statistical confidence.
items.summary_zh: 地球变暖的速度已达到有记录以来的最快水平，科学家们发现，自2015年左右以来，全球气温上升速度显著加快。 一项新研究显示，变暖速率已飙升至每十年约0.35°C，几乎是1970年至2015年间观测到的平均速度的两倍。在剔除自然气候波动因素后，研究人员以超过98%的统计置信度证实了这一加速趋势。

items.title: 128,000-year-old ice in Tibet could rewrite climate history
items.title_en: 128,000-year-old ice in Tibet could rewrite climate history
items.title_zh: 西藏12.8万年前的冰层或将改写气候史
items.summary_en: Ancient ice discovered high in Tibet may be more than 128,000 years old, preserving an extraordinary record of Earth's climate that scientists previously thought had been lost. The discovery reveals a rare glimpse into the last ice age and could reshape our understanding of how glaciers survive dramatic changes in global climate.
items.summary_zh: 在西藏高海拔地区发现的远古冰层可能已有超过12.8万年的历史，其中保存着地球气候的非凡记录——科学家此前曾认为这些记录早已消失。这一发现让我们得以罕见地一窥上一次冰河时期的景象，并可能重塑我们对冰川如何在全球气候剧变中存续的理解。

items.title: Scientists discover a hidden oxygen reservoir deep inside Earth
items.title_en: Scientists discover a hidden oxygen reservoir deep inside Earth
items.title_zh: 科学家在地球深处发现了一个隐藏的氧气储库
items.summary_en: Scientists have discovered that magma deep inside Earth can store surprising amounts of extra oxygen, potentially revealing a hidden contributor to our planet's oxygen-rich atmosphere. The findings suggest that ancient volcanic eruptions may have helped transform Earth's atmosphere billions of years ago, with implications for understanding life on other planets.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现，地球深处的岩浆中可以储存惊人的额外氧气，这可能揭示了地球富氧大气中一个隐藏的来源。这一发现表明，数十亿年前的古代火山喷发可能曾帮助重塑了地球的大气层，这对理解其他行星上的生命具有重要意义。

items.title_en: Antarctica’s “Doomsday Glacier” could raise sea levels twice as much as predicted
items.title_zh: 南极洲的“末日冰川”可能导致海平面上升幅度达到此前预测值的两倍
items.summary_en: Antarctica’s Thwaites Glacier may be melting twice as much as previously predicted, even without additional global warming. Scientists discovered that warm ocean water is penetrating miles beneath the ice, weakening its foundations and accelerating its retreat. A new model predicts that the glacier could add up to 30 millimeters to global sea levels by 2100, with a 60% chance of losing a crucial stabilizing ridge.
items.summary_zh: 南极洲的斯威茨冰川的融化速度可能达到此前预测值的两倍，即使全球变暖不再加剧也是如此。科学家发现，温暖的海水正向冰层下方数英里处渗透，削弱了冰川的基础，并加速了其后退。 一项新模型预测，到2100年，该冰川可能导致全球海平面上升多达30毫米，且有60%的概率会失去一条至关重要的稳定山脊。
